issue.title: docs: add concept and configuration pages
issue.body:
**Is your feature request related to a problem? Please describe.**

As a new team member I joined my colleague on a Go project where we use `goreleaser`. Looking at the docs at goreleaser.com I am unable to understand in detail what this tool does and how to configure it.

**Describe the solution you'd like**

I am mainly missing two things from the docs:

1) something like a CONCEPT page where the workflow / idea / concept of goreleaser is described. First we fire before-hooks, then we build, then we package and sign ...
2) Explain the configuration file. Even with an existing config file I feel unable to modify things because I have no way to lookup what is supported and what each value expects.

**Describe alternatives you've considered**

* Reading the code - if this is expected to use goreleaser please do it as part of your guides/docs
